Featuring:

notes.title: 06/03/2024 Patch
notes.notes:
In this patch our main focus were usability and UI fixes, mainly:

- Level selection - fixed default level selection not appearing when moving to some regions
- Level selection - navigation fixes when coming back from a level (WSAD / Arrows / Enter + Space keys)
- Settings panel - fixed resolutions dropdown, removed resolutions smaller than 800 x 600 (Left this one as a minimum value In case someone would want to launch the game on some virtual machine :P)
- UI elements - added additional safety measures for situations, when multiple UI elements could appear one after another (Especially for the game over screen situations)
- Fixing missing glyphs for UI elements (Especially when coming back to level selection screen)

notes.title: Paint by Cubes is going Live now! Happy gaming!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Going Live![/b][/h1]
Paint by Cubes is now available worldwide - why not try it yourself? ;)

There is quite a number of levels and they're all split into gameplay mechanic themed regions - each level selection region comes with a new mechanic, that's starting to appear throughout the levels available in this region and stay with the player for the next game sections.

Within the region, it's up to you if you'll go for the 100% region completionist goal or just rush for the last in-region level (completeing which will give you access to new region and set of levels).

You'll also encounter number of skull-iconed levels - these are typically the more difficult ones, often with a more complex pattern you'll need to find on the level ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258199/184fc3cdaf604f531d61625d61f31a970a8f7431.png[/img]

[h1][b]Further development plans![/b][/h1]

In the upcoming days we'll be uploading some small updates to the game, adding more/better tutorials, adding some additional in-game visual effects and adding some additional polish to the UI scaling and elements.

As for the next bigger steps, we've already started development of our first DLC and it will be available in next couple months - we'll keep you updated on how the development is progressing :)

The DLC will mostly focus on a couple sets of new regions with additional mechanics, that are already in the level-planning phase - stay tuned and have fun with our game!

[h1][b]Feedback[/b][/h1]

We strongly encourage you to post all your feedback about the game in the Community Hub - we'll try to include them in our next planned game updates!

notes.title: Last updates before official launch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi![/h1]

The game content is ready for release and all levels / achievements are setup and ready to go for the release :)

As the game went through a Steam's testing process, we've received update from the Steam support team that we'll need to add some minor improvements to the Xbox controller support in UI popups and reset configuration of the Steam Cloud saves to work properly.

We'll be uploading final building with fixes for this issue on Monday, the game should be ready for launch near the mid/late parts of next week - because of that the release will happen on the 1st March 2024!

Stay tuned!
Last Qubit Team

notes.title: New levels and updated localizations for our demo build!
notes.notes:
[h1]New set of levels showcasing new game mechanics added to the demo![/h1]

We've uploaded new demo version of the game in which you can test our new set of levels! Level selection screen now hosts a new levels path containing 8 new maps to try, all of them are focused on a new mechanic - blocks with limited number of moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258199/ee607a93847a8d02c02cd5917eb867b49c3ff316.png[/img]

Blocks with limited number of possible moves are a new interesting mechanic in "Paint by Cubes". 

Whenever the player enters such a block, the counter on top of it reduces by 1. Whenever the counter reaches 0, the block becomes inaccessible and from that point the player can't enter it anymore.

There is only one possibility to color such a block correctly - the player needs to enter it from a correct direction at the moment when the counter finishes countdown and reaches 0.

[h1]New localizations added![/h1]

With the new updated, there were two changes regarding the localization system.

You can now enter Settings panel from the top-right corner of our Level Selection screen. In the Settings screen we've added a new section - the language selection dropdown list.

As the game starts with the default localization language based on your device's setup, you can now modify current game language using the newly added picker!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258199/ec675754073e4948f401af976d1da660288e5cdd.png[/img]

We've also added new localizations to our game - now you can play "Paint by Cubes" in:

notes.title: Demo is Live NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]First demo version release![/h1]
We're glad to inform you that our first demo version is available for you to play since today. You can download the demo using 'Paint by Cubes' Steam page, just navigate to the [u][b]Download Demo[/b][/u] button and you can start playing!

The demo hosts a limited number of levels, starting from a simple tutorial and having two final, very complicated levels at the end (with a big difficulty spike).

We'd love to hear all your feedback as it will help us improve the demo version and the final version of the game :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258199/de1cd12795629ca4306cc18c14a3b8416a14fac6.png[/img]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

Currently we're working on the demo improvements (adding some UX improvements, preparing Music and Sound effects for the game) so these features will be included into the demo build soon.

We'll be adding a couple additional levels to the demo version in the next 2 weeks time, so we'll be updating you using the Steam events section when it happens.

[h1]Demo Feedback[/h1]

Your feedback is very valuable for us, as it will help improve the Demo and the final version of the game. If you'll have any feedback about current game mechanics, ideas for new mechanics or just simple bug reports, please share them with us using the game's [b]Community Hub[/b] or by joining our [b]Discord server[/b] using the [u][b]Visit our Discord[/b][/u] button on the game's Store page!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258199/d7bd7d9fc810ea9506b0d05e093d0835b3b17493.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
We're glad to see you in our [b]'Paint by Cubes' community[/b]!

We'd been able to setup our Steampage recently and we're still finishing some of the preparations to make this environment as useful and clear to you as possible :)

We're trying to consistently to fill our game's page with animated gifs, game details and to update screenshots in order to make it more and more clear for the players what the gameplay loop is and to let them feel the colorful, relaxing world of our painting.

We're now working on our first trailer, that will surely explaing game mechanics even better and will be a good source of information for any new people, that are looking for relaxing puzzle games!

[h1]Demo announcement[/h1]
This is the most important information of this event, the thing that lots of people are asking us on our social media ;)

We're currently finishing our first demo build in order to publish it in upcoming weeks. We've already hosted some small scale playtests and we're improving the first time user experience and some of the info popups so that it will be even more clear how to start your adventure with 'Paint by Cubes' and which way to go later on as you'll get some progress in the solved puzzles ;)

[u][b]We're currently waiting for our Demo's Steam page acceptation, so we'll be uploading the demo version of the game on the 3th of July[/b][/u]! 

The package with demo build was already accepted by Steam support, the Steam page required a small change to the game icons, so now it's just a formality to be ready for the great release :)
